active.text: STYLE LOCK: Warm cinematic live-action children’s picture-book adaptation; soft practical lamp light and dusk exteriors; gentle shallow depth of field; consistent photoreal fur and fabric detail across all cast; no cartoon stretch or stylized proportions.

PERFORMANCE LOCK: Objective picture-book staging with rhyming off-screen narrator; on-screen characters look at each other and at scene action (leash, treat, bed, stairs), not the viewer; Buster plays physical comedy to Mom’s cues; Mom addresses Buster directly in gentle firm caregiver mode; Daddy is quiet present background in bed.
